items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for the managed fleet; blocked for public launch of the gated product. Evidence: fleet_doctor.ok=false with no run, checks, or site results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps unavailable; security sitefacts are unknown for all 59 scoped sites; no TLS certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but certificate coverage is not evidenced; compliance records 35 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown. Authentication, access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency and supply-chain risk, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness therefore remain unverified. Severity: high for launch decisions, not an automatic block on ordinary low-risk growth. Recommendation: retain the existing bounded read-only security evidence work, preserve unknowns, do not request duplicate telemetry, and keep the gated product private until material security and other launch gates are complete.

No new security proposal or change request is retained. Existing security work already covers the required evidence boundary. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, change permissions, modify production, deploy, or claim certification. Ordinary reversible growth may continue where independently authorized, but no security-sensitive release or public exposure should proceed on missing evidence alone.

SearchWoot remains blocked from public exposure on security grounds because access, secret, isolation, TLS, dependency, monitoring, incident, and disclosure evidence is incomplete. This is compounded by unresolved rights, privacy, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates. Keep the private gate unchanged and permit only bounded read-only evidence work and internal drafting.
